notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2_3.b7c2: Stuck Delivery Workers
notes.notes: [p]Dear players 🥐[/p][p][/p][p]You may have encountered an issue where delivery workers remained stuck inside the truck, holding boxes without placing them into storage.[/p][p][/p][p][b]This problem has been fixed in this patch.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We will keep addressing issues and adjusting the game balance.[/p][p]Stay tuned, and don’t hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2_2.b7c2: Table Numbers & Bugs
notes.notes: [p]Dear Managers,[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the changes included in this version. They mainly come from your feedback, as well as some bugs we detected.[/p][p][/p][h1]Rework of table numbers[/h1][p]When ordering a dish with the tablet, it is no longer necessary to select a table. A dish ordered without an associated table will not have a ticket with a table number.[/p][p]For dishes ordered and associated with a table, it is now possible to deliver them to another table with a different number. This is no longer blocked.[/p][p]Employees will now only pick up dishes from the counter if they are associated with a table.[/p][p][/p][h3]Changes[/h3][p]- Serving dishes by employees is now counted towards mission objectives to unlock new dishes.[/p][p]- Boxes containing a floor can now be resold to Joe.[/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][p]- Fixed the truck not leaving its delivery point.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue that caused tables to be marked as invalid (red) without any valid reason.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Reminder[/b][/p][p]If, when starting your game, you see some of your tables marked in red, it means their placement is invalid. Simply move them to fix it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What's next?[/b][/p][p]We are moving into a new phase of adjustments and bug fixes, including:[/p][p]- a parameter to adjust how quickly satisfaction increases [/p][p]- a key to toggle sprint[/p][p]- a better sales report[/p][p][/p][p]At the same time, we are progressing on the roadmap, including:[/p][p]- achievements coming very soon[/p][p]- a new language being added in the game[/p][p]- new decoration props (we will release a devlog dedicated to this topic)[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2.b7c2 – Musics
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dear Managers,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This hotfix focuses on adding and removing certain music tracks.
Although they were royalty-free for commercial use, some of them could still trigger alerts for content creators.[/p][p][/p][p]To avoid this, we removed the problematic tracks and added a new, more modern one.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support and feedback. The next update will focus on several fixes reported in the past few days, including a long-awaited change:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]The rework of table numbers.[/b][/h2][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1.b7c2 – Employee Blocking Fix
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dear Managers,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The placement of tables previously allowed certain invalid positions, which could block employees.[/p][p]This hotfix adds additional checks to prevent such invalid placements.[/p][p][/p][h1]⚠️ [b]Attention[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Your already placed tables may now be flagged as invalid and appear in [b]red[/b].
If this happens, simply move the table or place it in a box to set it aside.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/70a48de58d78dcaaf5ab534ce8e2c1e4ad42d52f.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve taken into account your recent bug reports, whether shared through the hub, Discord/QQ, or your Steam reviews. Please know that we are moving forward tirelessly and carefully considering each of your feedback to refine the game experience. A new update is coming soon with many adjustments, and we’ll be bringing you the content from the roadmap very shortly.[/p][p]Thank you all for your interest in the game. We continue working to provide you with a stable experience and new features. [b]Stay tuned, more is coming soon! 🥐[/b][/p]

notes.title: (Demo) Hotfix v0.0.9.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Managers,[/h3]

We have just released a new patch to address several issues.

Here are the changes included:

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]Storage was not being deducted when a guest placed a food order
[*]If a guest disconnected while holding an object, it was destroyed
[*]Fixed sprint replication, which could cause desynchronization
[*]Fixed replication when a guest was holding an object, which also caused desynchronization
[*]Deliveries could occur in parallel on the guest side
[*]Placing dishes from the tray caused issues
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the placement of boxes in the truck
[*]Increased running speed
[*]Increased tolerance for interacting with bar bottles/machines — it's no longer necessary to be directly in front
[*]Reviewed supply prices
[*]Fixed an issue where clients would leave if too many dishes were disabled
[*]After quitting a session, the "Load" button on the main menu no longer appeared
[*]Fixed translation issues
[/list]

If the game crashes at launch, try starting it with DirectX 11.

Also, make sure to update your graphics drivers — it's an important step.

Feel free to join us on Discord if you encounter any bugs or crashes. We're doing everything we can to resolve them as quickly as possible!

notes.title: Update 0.0.7.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear managers,[/h3]

We have just released a new update !

Here are all the changes:

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*]New musics ! (based on our players' feedback, previous one seems to be boring for some of you)
[*]New notification when Ace of the Tray mission is completed
[*]Tray stabilization (previous tray movements caused motion sickness)
[*]Roadmap directly in-game
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Delivery truck sometimes blocked in traffic, causing it to not come at delivery point
[*]Customers can be stuck at billing computer (TO TEST PLEASE)
[*]Softlock possible at Prologue : Part 2
[*]Softlock possible at Prologue : Part 4/ 5 / 6 if customer leave after waiting too long
[*]Softlock possible if saving at end day when Prologue : Part 8 is in progress
[*]Delivery guys sometimes take cardboard through delivery truck, not going inside
[*]Tables can be place too close of certain walls, causing customers to be blocked
[*]First time opening IPEA app not showing any furniture
[*]Merging and splitting in Prologue : Part 1 break "placing furniture" count
[*]Bottle appear on dispenser even if there is no glass in stock (but anim is not played so dispenser is locked)
[*]Merge and split tables too close of brasserie walls could spawn cardboard outdoor
[*]Sometimes dishes cannot be selected anymore on tray
[*]Sometimes, customers could get stuck at the reception at the end of the day
[/list]

[b]Changed[/b]
[list]
[*]Premium delivery is now the default checked delivery, be careful if you prefer economical
[*]Help widgets positions has been improved (especially for mini fridge)
[*]Truck wheels no longer collide with cardboard
[*]Remove virtual density of vehicles, now there is same amount of vehicles throughout the day
[*]Better boxes display in rack (one will appear at first cardboard put in)
[*]Modification of the "Rosé" notification to better distinguish it from "Red wine"
[*]Modification of the "Pear Liqueur" notification to better distinguish it from "Génépi"
[*]Motion blur will now be disabled by default
[/list]

notes.title: Valentine's Day Update (0.0.6.0) !
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Managers,[/h3]

We have just released a new update for Valentine's Day!

Here are all the changes:

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a "Smart Margins" button to the Menu app
[*]Added automatic saving when changing days
[*]Added a dish filter in the eRundis app
[*]Added keys for fun interactions in the HUD
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the Ray-Tracing option being enabled on unsupported graphics cards
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the brasserie doors from closing in certain cases
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed changing days without closing the brasserie doors in certain cases
[*]Fixed the economic delivery option not being available even after the first order
[*]Fixed the end-of-day time display, it will now correctly show 00:00 instead of 00:01
[/list]

[b]Changed[/b]
[list]
[*]Reworked table placement, they now take up much less space
[*]Reduced restricted placement areas
[*]Balanced the economy (lowered the cost of certain ingredients and tables, increased possible margins)
[*]The "Smart Order" button in the eRundis app no longer takes disabled dishes into account
[*]When a computer app is closed, filters are reset
[*]The bottom bar in the HUD will remain visible even when using the computer
[*]Reduced the delay to close the brasserie doors when the last group leaves
[*]Lowered the ingredient threshold before appearing as "Low Stock"
[*]Changed the font for better readability of pinned missions
[*]Increased starting money from €3,000 to €5,000
[*]Changed the default key for the tray, now set to E
[*]Increased glass opacity for better visibility
[*]Added the ability to exit the computer using the ESC key
[/list]
